messages:
emily_cs: Heads-up — renewal for AuroGrid (ent) looks risky. Usage dropped ~60% in last 14d after infrastructure lead change. New infra lead Tom is evaluating alternatives; apparently running a 2-week proof with HollowayAI. Can we triage? :warning:

mike_sales: Noted. I pinged Tom last week but no reply. @emily_cs can you share last 30d usage delta and top failing routes?

raj_eng: grabbing stats now. If their dedicated pool is partial, cache warmup could explain tokens drop. Will run a quick query.

raj_eng: ```sql
SELECT date, sum(tokens) as tokens
FROM usage.events
WHERE account_id = 'auroid-342'
  AND date >= CURRENT_DATE - interval '30 days'
GROUP BY date
ORDER BY date;
```

ops_bot: query queued — job id 7852. ETA ~2m :hourglass: 

sara_csm: I had a 1:1 with the previous champion (Priya) — she said Tom wanted lower latency and a better billing estimate. HollowayAI is promising 30% cost reduction. We should surface batch/caching config and a side-by-side cost estimate.

emily_cs: Agreed. @raj_eng can you produce a quick cost delta for their current config vs the recommended batching + 4-bit quant profile? If we can show cost neutral + better latency, might lock them.

raj_eng: I'll run a perf/cost sim. Also, any logs of token errors? If model fallback is happening that'll reduce usage.

mike_sales: I'll try to re-open the convo with Tom. Planning to propose a 2-week Dedicated trial with auto-fallback to hosted API — includes SLA credit. Thoughts? :+1:

sara_csm: thumbs up. Also let's schedule a short enablement session for their infra team — 30m walkthrough of routing policies & cache hints. I can host Wed 11am PT. cc @emily_cs

emily_cs: Wed 11am PT works. For now, I'll send a 'quiet account' note to CSM doc and flag renewal. Also attaching a short checklist:

emily_cs: ```text
- Deliver 30d usage + top routes (raj)
- Cost delta (raj)
- 30m enablement invite (sara)
- Sales escalation & trial terms (mike)
- Follow-up with Tom, confirm timeline (emily)
```

ops_bot: job 7852 completed — attached results: 30d tokens down 58%, top impacted routes: /chat/completion, /embeddings. (link: https://redwood.data/queries/7852/results) :mag_right:

emily_cs: Thanks — saving link. I'll draft outreach: 'We've noticed usage change after infra lead change. Can we sync to avoid service disruption? We're offering a short Dedicated trial + enablement to prove perf/cost.' Sending now. :envelope_with_arrow:
